raw.rationale: NU-7026 is a dual DNA-PK/mTOR/PI3K inhibitor whose cytotoxicity at 2.5 µM is likely driven mainly by DNA-PK inhibition and chemosensitization rather than single-agent lineage-selective killing; PRISM single-agent screens of DNA-PK inhibitors typically show few or no lineage-selective effects, with modest exceptions in PTEN/PI3K-pathway-altered lineages such as breast, uterus, and CNS. Base rates of 0.2-2.5% per lineage are therefore only slightly elevated for plausible PI3K/mTOR- or DNA-repair-dependent lineages.
